name: Kutsuno Kanade
source:
Class: 1-B

A girl on a wheelchair who lives at her grandparents' house which also serves as a hot springs inn. She used to be a very kind and content girl, but turned into a very mischievous little devil. Despite being bad at studying, Kanade makes up it by being a very friendly girl. Kanade is always very grateful, as she has been living her life by the help of the others due to her disability. Due to this, she often thinks asking help might burden the people around her. She calls the protagonist "oni-sama."

In Amakano ~Second Season~+:
Bust-Waist-Hips: 84-54-83cm
